visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men, one in a grey checked blazer and one in a black pinstriped shirt, stand in a dressing room. The man in grey adjusts his large silver chain necklace while looking into a mirror. The man in black, with visible tattoos, leans in. Bright vanity lights illuminate the scene. (2) The scene cuts to a large stage with a vibrant blue and orange graphic background featuring the text "UBJ". The two men stand behind individual floor microphones. The man in grey gestures emphatically with his hands while speaking, while the man in black stands in a confident pose with one hand on his hip. (3) The lighting is high-contrast stage lighting. The man in grey points directly at the camera with a serious expression. The man in black places a hand on his partner's shoulder in a supportive gesture. They move rhythmically as if performing a dramatic song for an audience. (4) They are now outdoors on a red carpet walkway next to a modern building. Both are laughing heartily. The man in grey points to the man in black's chest. The man in black pulls his shirt collar down to show a red mark on his pectoral muscle, smiling widely.
